concept.title: Free trials and tasters
concept.shortdesc: Free or low-cost introductory consultations, trial passes and taster sessions to try a service or activity before committing.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : A free first meeting, consultation, quote or assessment offered before committing to a service.
: A free or low-cost try-out of a session, class, pass or service before joining or paying regularly.
: Short introductory taster sessions, often free, that let people sample an activity or group.
